description: Simulated grouped data: 30 schools, a school-level random intercept, school-level variables zs and zt, observation-level z1, z2, z3. The column school holds the cluster id.
generator_code:
{
    g <- 30L
    school <- rep(seq_len(g), sample(8:40, g, replace = TRUE))
    n <- length(school)
    zs <- runif(g, 0, 10)
    zt <- factor(sample(c("urban", "rural", "peri"), g, replace = TRUE))
    u <- rnorm(g, 0, 1.5)[school]
    d <- data.frame(school = school, x = rnorm(n), zs = zs[school], zt = zt[school], z1 = runif(n, 0, 
        10), z2 = factor(sample(c("a", "b", "c"), n, replace = TRUE)), z3 = rnorm(n))
    e <- rnorm(n)
    left <- d$z1 <= 5
    d$y_gauss <- u + ifelse(left, 1 + 2 * d$x, -1 + 0.5 * d$x) + e
    d$y_bin <- as.integer(runif(n) < plogis(u + ifelse(left, -0.5 + d$x, 0.5 - d$x)))
    d[sample(n), ]
}
